t: Introduction and overview — F-35 Lightning II
name: Introduction and overview — F-35 Lightning II — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — F-35 Lightning II
description: Introduction and overview of the F-35 Lightning II: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The F-35 Lightning II is a single-engine stealth multirole fighter built by Lockheed Martin, with three variants: the conventional F-35A, the short-takeoff/vertical-landing F-35B, and the carrier-based F-35C. It reached initial operating capability with the U.S. Marine Corps in 2015. Over 1,000 airframes have been delivered to U.S. services and allied nations. Baseline facts: Single-engine stealth multirole fighter; three variants A/B/C; 1,000+ delivered by Lockheed Martin..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: F-35 Lightning II: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
